public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI bubble will unravel over the next few months and years, with concentration risk across nearly every part of the industry.
public_payload.original_horizon_text: in the next few months and years

statement.excerpt: I bring this all up because you’re going to hear this term, or variations of this term, a lot in the next few months and years as the AI bubble unravels, because just about every part of the industry involves its own flavor of concentration risk.

from_speaker: in the next few months and years
just about every part of the industry
its own flavor of concentration risk
our_interpretation: Unravels means a broad reversal of the AI investment boom, visible across financing, valuations and infrastructure investment, rather than one company's setback.
Concentration risk means material dependence on a small set of customers, funders, suppliers or counterparties across the industry's main segments.
The timing phrase indicates the coming months and years but supplies no finite latest date. Assigning an exact number of years would invent a deadline.
More frequent use of the term is an accompanying expectation, not sufficient evidence that the financial unwind occurred.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes a broad, sustained AI investment unwind accompanied by material concentration exposures across the principal industry segments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A bounded version could be contradicted by sustained expansion without the claimed unwind through its deadline. This wording supplies no finite deadline, so continued expansion alone cannot conclusively falsify it.
